title: krajekisbtc Polymarket skills exfiltrate crypto private keys over the Telegram Bot API
summary: A ClawHub cluster published by the account `krajekisbtc` — including `polymarketbtc` and `polymarketbtcassistant` — exfiltrated cryptocurrency private keys through the Telegram Bot API instead of the shared dropper infrastructure used by the rest of the ClawHavoc wave. Unit 42 calls this out explicitly as a distinct cluster with an independent C2 channel: blocking the 91.92.242[.]30 infrastructure, which is what most ClawHavoc IOC lists cover, does nothing against it.
details:
**Why it is tracked separately from SKA-2026-0001 and SKA-2026-0004:** the other Polymarket-themed advisories in this database cover the mass-cloned prerequisite droppers (SKA-2026-0001) and the `better-polymarket` / `polymarket-all-in-one` reverse-shell backdoor (SKA-2026-0004). This cluster shares the Polymarket theme and the ClawHub distribution channel but has its own publisher account and its own exfiltration channel.

**Why Telegram is the interesting part:** `api.telegram.org` is a high-reputation host that most network controls allow, and the bot token embedded in the skill is the whole C2 configuration. Domain- and IP-reputation defences fail here by design; the detectable signal is the credential access plus an outbound POST carrying it.

**What a deterministic scanner sees:** reading wallet/private-key material (`credential-leak`) and posting it to a messaging API endpoint (`exfiltration`). SkillWarden flags Telegram Bot API endpoints as a callback channel; it cannot distinguish a legitimate Telegram notifier skill from this one on the endpoint alone — that judgement is the `credential-leak` + `exfiltration` co-occurrence, not either rule by itself.

**Fact vs. inference:** the publisher account, the two named skills, the targeted data and the Telegram Bot API channel are as published by Unit 42 (2026-06-23) in its summary of early ClawHub campaign activity; Unit 42 says "and related skills", so the two names below are not necessarily the complete set. No per-skill hashes are published for this cluster. Verified 2026-08-04.
